name: Pachibare! Patchwork Valentine
source:
――Seven love stories, started by chocolate with no recipient.

The protagonist isn't celebrating Valentine's Day.

On Valentine's Day Eve, chocolate mysteriously appears on her desk!

Did someone put it here by mistake?
Or is there something more to this?

She finds herself suddenly involved in romantic happenings.
Just what will come of all this?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29882]Freem![/url]]
